item.description: The McLaren driver tripled his 2026 win count in a single day, going back-to-back to win Race 2 and Race 1 at the Milwaukee Mile.

item.title: How World War II Rationing Led To 35 MPH Speed Limits And Bans On Driving For Fun
item.description: Fuel and rubber shortages during the war meant strict limits on how much driving you could do, how fast you could go, and whether or not you could buy a car.
